PURBASHA GRAMIN BANK
(A fictional bank) · Siliguri Branch

Date: 15th October 2026

To,
Sujata Das
74, Station Road, Siliguri, West Bengal - 734001

Sub: Reminder for overdue instalments in Loan Account No. 376583942701

Dear Customer,

This is to inform you that 2 EMI(s) of Rs. 3,250.00 each in your above loan account are overdue since 10th August 2026. The total overdue amount is Rs. 6,500.00, and penal interest of Rs. 260.00 has been levied as per the sanction terms.

You are requested to pay Rs. 6,760.00 on or before 22nd October 2026 to regularise the account.

Please note that if the dues are not cleared, the account will be classified as a Non-Performing Asset (NPA) on 8th November 2026, which will affect your credit score, and the Bank may initiate recovery proceedings as per law.

If you have already paid, please ignore this letter.

Yours faithfully,
Branch Manager

SYNTHETIC SAMPLE · made up for testing Chithi · not a real letter
